description: Hand-authored, deterministic raw-telemetry replay fixture (gate G1.2). Exercises raw record -> SourceAdapter -> Observation -> the real G1.0 DetectionEngine -> Evidence. Unlike phase0_benign_scenarios.json, no scenario here asserts its own rule id or ATT&CK mapping -- whether anything fires, and what it maps to, is decided entirely by evaluating these scenarios against fixtures/phase1_core_rules.json. Not real detection-engineering content; not used to validate detection efficacy.
